# RPi3 Boot Hang Handoff (2026-07-10)

## Session Summary
Continued debugging RPi3 boot hang after `cpu::init_on_bsp()` returns.

## Root Cause Identified
`init_after_heap()` hangs when trying to allocate `BootInfo` using 
`String::to_string()` and `Vec::to_vec()` inside `INFO.call_once()`.
The global heap allocator (`osdk-heap-allocator`'s `HeapAllocator`) may not 
be fully functional at this point, or `cpu_local` storage is not ready.

## Committed Changes (2026-07-10)
- `aarch64_support@0d76c2b0`: Replace spin::Once with SimpleOnce, fix init order

## Key Files
- `ostd/src/lib.rs`: Main init sequence with debug markers
- `ostd/src/boot/mod.rs`: `SimpleOnce`, `INFO`, `EARLY_INFO`, `init_after_heap()`
- `ostd/src/mm/heap/mod.rs`: `HEAP_ALLOCATOR` / `AllocDispatch` - the global allocator
- `osdk/deps/heap-allocator/src/allocator.rs`: `HeapAllocator` - uses `cpu_local!` storage

## Next Steps
1. Verify if global heap allocator is initialized before `init_after_heap()` runs
2. Check if `cpu_local` storage (`LOCAL_POOL`) is functional when `INFO.call_once()` runs
3. Consider deferring `BootInfo` creation to avoid heap allocation during early init
4. Alternative: use stack/bss allocations for early boot info instead of heap
